blocks.html: So far, in terms of sound production, we’ve explored triggering synths and recorded sounds via the fns play, synth and sample. These have then generated audio which has played through our stereo speaker system. However, many computers also have the ability to input sound, perhaps through a microphone, in addition to the ability to send sound out to more than two speakers. Often, this capability is made possible through the use of an external sound card - these are available for all platforms. In this section of the tutorial we’ll take a look at how we can take advantage of these external sound cards and effortlessly work with multiple channels of audio in and out of Sonic Pi.
